set.body: Goal: prove the renderer contract with a second independent implementer: a Scala.js Canvas backend (graphics-canvas module, js platform; optional JVM raster twin later) that consumes DeviceScene numeric primitives only. Acceptance: new module wired into build.sbt aggregates/aliases and README/module-relations per repo contract; backend implements RendererHarness and passes RendererConformance.check without any change to the graphics module; deterministic output verified where Canvas allows (command log or offscreen pixel hash); no plot semantics encoded in the backend.
set.title: Graphics: Canvas backend adopting the conformance contract
